tasks.title: Rename parseVerdict to parseResult with Result regex and backward compat
tasks.description: Rename VERDICT_RE to RESULT_RE matching `## Result: PASS|FAIL`. Rename parseVerdict to parseResult. Add backward compat: if RESULT_RE fails to match, try legacy VERDICT_RE as fallback with a deprecation log warning. Update the export in workflow-controller.ts and any import sites. Also add extractFixSuggestions pure function: extract content from `## Fix Suggestions` to end of file, return empty string if section missing.

tasks.title: Add escalateToStage to StageResult and handle in run() switch
tasks.spec: specs/pipeline-model/spec.md#CHECK stage 失败后回到 PLAN
tasks.description: Add optional `escalateToStage?: Stage` field to the StageResult interface. In the `run()` method's `Stage.Review` case, after calling `runPipelineReviewStage`, check if `reviewResult.escalateToStage` is set. If so, set the `no-auto-fix` checkpoint via `checkpointRepo.upsert(issue.number, 'review', ['no-auto-fix'], null)`, update issue stage back to the escalated stage (Build), and continue the while loop (break to re-enter the loop at Build stage).
acceptanceCriteria: StageResult interface has `escalateToStage?: Stage` field
run() Stage.Review case checks for escalateToStage after runPipelineReviewStage
When escalateToStage is Stage.Build: checkpoint 'no-auto-fix' is set, issue stage updated to Build, loop continues
When escalateToStage is not set: existing behavior unchanged (approval gate)
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: T-001 must be done first because the run() method uses parseResult.

tasks.title: Decompose runPipelineReviewStage and add auto-fix loop
tasks.description: Refactor `runPipelineReviewStage` into focused methods: (1) keep main method as orchestrator that runs R0/R1, then calls parseResult on reviewReport and branches; (2) add `runAutoFixLoop(issue, acpOptions, changeDir, reviewReport, fixSuggestions, roundState)` — iterates up to 2 attempts, each attempt = auto-fix round + re-verify round on fresh ACP connections, emits plan_round_start/session_update events for each round; (3) add `runReviewRound(issue, acpOptions, changeDir, roundType, roundIndex, prompt)` — single round helper that creates connection, emits events, runs prompt, closes connection. Check for `no-auto-fix` checkpoint at start: if present, skip auto-fix and return requiresApproval directly. On auto-fix PASS: add issue comment via commentRepo with Fix Suggestions content. On loop exhaustion: return `{ success: false, escalateToStage: Stage.Build }`.
acceptanceCriteria: runPipelineReviewStage calls parseResult after self-check and branches on PASS/FAIL
PASS path returns { success: true, requiresApproval: true } unchanged
FAIL path calls runAutoFixLoop
runAutoFixLoop creates fresh ACP connections for each auto-fix and re-verify round
Auto-fix round uses buildAutoFixPrompt(issue, changeDir, reviewReport)
Re-verify round uses buildReVerifyPrompt(issue, changeDir, reviewReport)
Auto-fix round failure is logged and counted as attempt (does not break loop)
After re-verify, parseResult is called on updated review.md to check PASS/FAIL
PASS after auto-fix: commentRepo.create called with Fix Suggestions, returns requiresApproval
2 failed attempts: returns { success: false, escalateToStage: Stage.Build }
no-auto-fix checkpoint checked at start of review stage: if present, FAIL skips auto-fix loop
plan_round_start events emitted for auto-fix (roundIndex 2,4) and re-verify (roundIndex 3,5) rounds
plan_session_update events emitted via onSessionUpdate callback for all rounds
Each helper method is under ~100 lines
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: This is the core task. Depends on T-001 (parseResult + extractFixSuggestions), T-002 (updated prompts), and T-003 (StageResult.escalateToStage + run() escalation handler).

tasks.title: Add integration test for review stage auto-fix loop
tasks.description: Write integration tests for the review stage auto-fix control flow: (1) PASS skips auto-fix, (2) FAIL + auto-fix PASS on first attempt → comment added + requiresApproval, (3) FAIL + auto-fix fails both attempts → escalateToStage Build, (4) no-auto-fix checkpoint present → FAIL skips loop. Mock ACP connections and commentRepo. Test the full runPipelineReviewStage flow.
